actions.input:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd, re
df_raw=pd.read_excel('field_visit_log.xlsx', sheet_name='Field Visit Log', header=None)
header_row=4
cols=df_raw.iloc[header_row].tolist()
data=df_raw.iloc[header_row+1:].copy()
data.columns=cols
# clean column names
data.columns=[str(c).strip() if pd.notna(c) else '' for c in data.columns]
print('cols', data.columns.tolist())
# keep relevant columns
# drop rows where Visit ID is NaN
data=data[data['Visit ID'].notna()]
# deduplicate by Visit ID keep first occurrence
data=data.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
# normalize village
def normalize_v(v):
    if pd.isna(v): return ''
    s=str(v).strip()
    s=re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()
data['village_norm']=data['Village'].apply(normalize_v)
# convert reached columns to numeric
for col in ['Women Reached','Men Reached','Children Reached']:
    data[col]=pd.to_numeric(data[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
data['total_people']=data['Women Reached']+data['Men Reached']+data['Children Reached']
# aggregate
agg=data.groupby('village_norm')['total_people'].sum().reset_index()
# title case for display
def title_case(s):
    return ' '.join(w.capitalize() for w in s.split())
agg['village_title']=agg['village_norm'].apply(title_case)
agg=agg.sort_values('total_people', ascending=False)
print(agg.head(20))
print('max', agg.iloc[0])
\"
"
